rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with network port scanning and web service discovery capabilities, built using Python with asyncio for concurrent scanning operations and comprehensive HTTP service detection. The implementation offers three core tools: port scanning with configurable port ranges and protocols, HTTP service enumeration with technology detection and response analysis, and admin directory discovery for security assessment, all featuring banner grabbing, service version detection, and detailed JSON result formatting with scan persistence. Built with Docker containerization, multiple interface options including CLI and HTTP modes, and robust error handling with configurable timeouts and concurrent connection limits, it serves security professionals conducting network reconnaissance through conversational interfaces, penetration testers needing natural language access to scanning capabilities, and network administrators performing infrastructure audits without direct command-line tool knowledge.
